messages.subject: Print broken?
parts:
So writing this in a model:

 print("x[1,1] = ", x[1,1], "x[1,2] = ",x[1,2], "x[1,3] = ",x[1,3]);

where x is a matrix produces this output:

x[1,1] = get_base1(x,1,1,"x",1)x[1,2] = get_base1(x,1,2,"x",1)x[1,3] = get_base1(x,1,3,"x",1)

I could swear this worked a month or two ago...

Thoughts?

Cheers,
Marcus
